name: zcash-explorer-api
description: Zcash Explorer API Server with PostgreSQL and WebSocket

scripts.test:redis: node -e "if (!process.env.TEST_REDIS_URL) throw new Error('TEST_REDIS_URL is required')" && node --test test/list-cache.redis.test.js
